_comment: Scene for the selected-army screen. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: army_division_list_view
windows._note: Measured with render_gui.py --verify on a game capture: the toolbar sits at y 187 + its file position. The frame itself starts at the top of the badge (y 83) and runs behind it; the code hides hq_window unless an HQ can be deployed and shows bottom_window only for the unassigned list.

windows.name: army_badge_view
windows._note: army_color_button is hidden by the code unless a colour is being picked.

manual: States a 1936 start does not show: combat icons, low supply, attrition, exile markers, a commander with traits
checklist: Division list: every row background, bars, warnings column, names in full
Scroll the list to the end
Open the change-template dropdown (12 templates, names on one line)
Army badge: name field, commander name, four stats, right area
